title: Revealing Multiple Nested Molecular Outflows with Rotating Signatures in HH270mms1-A with ALMA
question: Does the HH270mms1-A outflow consist of nested velocity components with rotation, and what are the launching radii of each component (disk wind vs X-wind)?

what.value: Disk and continuum properties of mms1-A/B (dust masses 161 and 56.7 Earth masses, separation 887 au, disk radius 90±10 au, Toomre Q)

evidence.quote: The dust mass of mms1-A and mms1-B is $161\,M_\oplus$ and $56.7\,M_\oplus$, respectively (cite: Tobin2020apj).
We adopted a protostellar mass of $M_{\ast} = 0.25 \,M_{\odot}$ based on the assumption in (cite: Tobin2020apj)
We assumed the CO abundance ratio with respect to H$_2$, $X_{\rm CO}=10^{-4}$ (cite: Frerking1982ApJ)

recipe.method: tclean with briggs weighting, hogbom deconvolver; uvtaper for one dataset

recipe.goal: Identify velocity components and jet knots; knot dynamical times
recipe.method: Channel maps and PV diagrams along axis; t_dyn = l_out/(v_LSR tan i)
assumptions: Inclination i=51.1 deg from continuum; jets normal to disk

recipe.goal: Outflow mass, mass loss rate, force, luminosity
recipe.method: LTE optically thin CO column density, M_out = mu m_H X_CO^-1 Omega d^2 N_CO; divided by t_dyn; 10 sigma boundary
assumptions: Column density varies within 20% for Tex 20-50 K

recipe.goal: Outflow rotation and launching radii (low, intermediate)
recipe.method: PV diagrams perpendicular to axis every 300 au; v_p, v_phi from blue/red peaks; r0 from Anderson et al. 2003 formula; Alfven radius and lever arm
assumptions: Axisymmetric rotating outflow; only redshifted lobe used

recipe.method: Keplerian radius r_K = GM/v_K^2 with v_K = v_LSR/cos i of knots (Kudoh & Shibata 1997)
assumptions: Knot plateau velocity equals Keplerian velocity at launch radius

evidence.quote: we estimated the outflow launching radii to be $67.1-77.1\,\text{au}$ for the low-velocity flow
$\Delta t_{\rm dyn} \sim 47.9$ years for the redshifted jet and $\Delta t_{\rm dyn} \sim 42.6$ years for the blueshifted one
The ratio $\lambda$ for the low-velocity outflow ranges from $\lambda = 2.18$ to $2.42$
with the maximum velocity of $\sim 80 \,\text{km\,s}^{-1}$ from the systemic velocity of mms1-A
